requests.reply: {"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "New hire onboarding guide"}, {"id": 1, "text": "Welcome to MoaLogis."}, {"id": 2, "text": "This document guides you through your tasks over the first two weeks ▶"}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Please contact Joonho Byun, Manager at 인사팀, for inquiries."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Seojin Um will assist you with setting up the development environment."}, {"id": 2, "text": "First day"}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Once you arrive, please first pick up your ID card at the 1st floor information desk."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "The access card you receive is registered by Manager Byeon Jun-ho."}, {"id": 1, "text": "The seats are next to the Dawn Team, and Um Seo-jin is also sitting in the same row."}, {"id": 2, "text": "We will have lunch with the team members."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Do not speak to the equipment operator first."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Submit the experience report to Team Manager for approval."}, {"id": 1, "text": "It will be delivered to Junho Manager upon confirmation."}, {"id": 2, "text": "First week"}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "New hires in MoaLogis will complete the 'Launchpad' task list during their first week."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Launchpad 1 involves wiki login and internal messaging registration."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Company announcements and casual conversations are made in the 'Hearth' channel."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Step 2 is to take the Pathfinder training for the fleet allocation system."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Try creating a daily fleet allocation plan yourself."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Do not upload the practice screen to the Hearth."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "The report doesn't need to be long."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Once the milestones are completed, you'll start working on real tasks from the second week."}, {"id": 2, "text": "Your first practical task will be a code review with Eumseojin."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "The code review results will be shared on the Mokbul Team channel."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Please ask Junho 변준호 Manager if you have any questions."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Finally, leave a one-line comment about the campfire."}]}

translations.10: We will have lunch with the team members.
translations.12: On the second day, you spend the whole day on-site.
translations.13: The unloading work is observed while wearing safety shoes.
translations.14: Do not speak to the equipment operator first.
translations.15: Submit the experience report to Team Manager for approval.
translations.16: It will be delivered to Junho Manager upon confirmation.
translations.18: New hires in MoaLogis will complete the 'Launchpad' task list during their first week.
translations.19: Launchpad 1 involves wiki login and internal messaging registration.
translations.20: Company announcements and casual conversations are made in the 'Hearth' channel.
translations.21: Leave a short self-introduction on Hearth.
translations.22: Step 2 is to take the Pathfinder training for the fleet allocation system.
translations.23: Try creating a daily fleet allocation plan yourself.
translations.24: Do not upload the practice screen to the Hearth.
translations.25: The report doesn't need to be long.
translations.26: Once the milestones are completed, you'll start working on real tasks from the second week.
translations.27: Your first practical task will be a code review with Eumseojin.
translations.28: The code review results will be shared on the Mokbul Team channel.
translations.29: Please ask Junho 변준호 Manager if you have any questions.
